analyst_view.overall: Early view: Kocaelispor (7th) under Selcuk Inan have been built on defence, with 9 goals conceded in 11 games and clean sheets in four of their first five home matches, and they won 2-0 at Eyupspor last time. Genclerbirligi (14th) changed coach in October, with Bernd Storck replacing Metin Diyadin, and come in with 12 goals scored and 21 conceded in 11 games and a 3-0 loss at Besiktas. The view will be refreshed with team news in the days before kick-off.

goals.text: The numbers say 1.9 goals. I lean slightly lower: Kocaelispor have scored only 13 and conceded 9 in 11 games and keep clean sheets at home, while Genclerbirligi have scored just 12. A tight 1-0 or 1-1 type of game fits both sides.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.0 corners. Nothing I found points either way: Kocaelispor should have more of the ball at home, but neither side has a strong attack that keeps pushing for set pieces.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards. I lean a little higher because Genclerbirligi are near the relegation places and their recent record includes a red card and a five-yellow ban (Ousmane Diabate and Metehan Baltaci, listed in the brief; both bans should be served well before this game). A side fighting to stay up away from home tends to pick up bookings.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.0 shots. I lean lower: Kocaelispor win games through structure rather than volume, and Genclerbirligi's attack has been among the weakest in the league this season, so a cagey game with fewer attempts looks more likely.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.0 shots on target. I lean slightly lower for the same reasons: two low-scoring attacks and a home side that defends well, with Serhat Oztasdelen in good form in goal for Kocaelispor.
